# Vendored browser runtime

- Egret Engine community rebuild, branch main, pinned commit [99dbb2cbcc1dae673b5320f350852ed09315138c](https://github.com/cnedwin/Egret_rebuild/tree/99dbb2cbcc1dae673b5320f350852ed09315138c).
- The contracts, runtime and engine packages were built from that Git checkout (tree 7f8a77cb20455a8c261a154284d8392d66f3de3a).
- Built with Node.js 26.7.0 and TypeScript 7.0.2 using upstream `node tools/build.mjs`.
- robust-predicates 3.0.3 is the engine dependency. The original license is retained next to the package.
